SELECT m.MATERIAL_CODE, m.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.STRUCTURE_NAME, d.STRUCTURE_TYPE, r.PRODUCT_STATUS, r.EMBRYO_CODE, r.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, r.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, m.BRAND, m.SPECIFICATIONS, m.MAIN_PATTERN, m.PATTERN, m.PRO_SIZE, m.SINGLE_TIRE_WEIGHT, m.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, r.MOULD_CAVITY_QTY, r.TYPE_BLOCK_QTY, max( d.AVERAGE_SALE_QTY ) AVERAGE_SALE_QTY, r.INVENTORY_SALES_RATIO, r.DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, sum( d.NET_QTY ) PROD_REQ_PLAN, sum( d.HEIGHT_QTY ) HEIGHT_QTY, sum( d.MID_QTY ) MID_QTY, sum( d.CYCLE_RESERVE_QTY ) CYCLE_RESERVE_QTY, r.TOTAL_QTY, r.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, sum( d.NET_QTY ) - r.TOTAL_QTY DIFFERENCE_QTY, r.BEGIN_DAY, r.END_DAY, r.DAY_1, r.DAY_2, r.DAY_3, r.DAY_4, r.DAY_5, r.DAY_6, r.DAY_7, r.DAY_8, r.DAY_9, r.DAY_10, r.DAY_11, r.DAY_12, r.DAY_13, r.DAY_14, r.DAY_15, r.DAY_16, r.DAY_17, r.DAY_18, r.DAY_19, r.DAY_20, r.DAY_21, r.DAY_22, r.DAY_23, r.DAY_24, r.DAY_25, r.DAY_26, r.DAY_27, r.DAY_28, r.DAY_29, r.DAY_30, r.DAY_31, F.DAY_27 LAST_27, F.DAY_28 LAST_28, F.DAY_29 LAST_29, F.DAY_30 LAST_30, F.DAY_31 LAST_31, F.PRODUCTION_VERSION LAST_PRODUCTION_VERSION, '1' DATA_TYPE, '2' LOCATION_TYPE /*内外销，目前没有地方取，暂时固定外销*/ FROM T_MDM_MATERIAL_INFO m LEFT JOIN T_DP_DEMAND_PLAN d ON d.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{dayResult.monthPlanVersion} AND d.FACTORY_CODE = m.FACTORY_CODE AND d.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE AND d.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MP_MOULDING_DAY_RESULT r ON m.MATERIAL_CODE = r.MATERIAL_CODE AND m.FACTORY_CODE = r.FACTORY_CODE AND r.production_version = #{dayResult.productionVersion} AND r.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f ON f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = m.MATERIAL_CODE AND f.`YEAR_MONTH` = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(concat(#{dayResult.year},'-',#{dayResult.month},'-1'),INTERVAL 1 month), '%Y%m') WHERE m.FACTORY_CODE = #{dayResult.factoryCode} AND m.IS_DELETE = 0 AND m.STRUCTURE_NAME IS NOT NULL
AND m.FACTORY_CODE = r.FACTORY_CODE
GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_CODE, m.MES_MATERIAL_CODE, m.MATERIAL_DESC, m.STRUCTURE_NAME, d.STRUCTURE_TYPE, r.PRODUCT_STATUS, r.EMBRYO_CODE, r.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, r.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE, m.BRAND, m.SPECIFICATIONS, m.MAIN_PATTERN, m.PATTERN, m.PRO_SIZE, m.SINGLE_TIRE_WEIGHT, m.PRODUCT_CATEGORY, r.MOULD_CAVITY_QTY, r.TYPE_BLOCK_QTY, r.INVENTORY_SALES_RATIO, r.DAY_VULCANIZATION_QTY, r.TOTAL_QTY, r.HEIGHT_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.MID_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CYCLE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.CONVENTION_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.POSTPONE_PRODUCTION_QTY, r.TOTAL_QTY, r.BEGIN_DAY, r.END_DAY, r.DAY_1, r.DAY_2, r.DAY_3, r.DAY_4, r.DAY_5, r.DAY_6, r.DAY_7, r.DAY_8, r.DAY_9, r.DAY_10, r.DAY_11, r.DAY_12, r.DAY_13, r.DAY_14, r.DAY_15, r.DAY_16, r.DAY_17, r.DAY_18, r.DAY_19, r.DAY_20, r.DAY_21, r.DAY_22, r.DAY_23, r.DAY_24, r.DAY_25, r.DAY_26, r.DAY_27, r.DAY_28, r.DAY_29, r.DAY_30, r.DAY_31, F.YEAR , F.MONTH , F.DAY_27 , F.DAY_28 , F.DAY_29 , F.DAY_30 , F.DAY_31 , F.PRODUCTION_VERSION ORDER BY PRO_SIZE, STRUCTURE_NAME, MOULD_CAVITY_QTY DESC, TYPE_BLOCK_QTY DESC, MAIN_PATTERN
